# Read-only scan of C/E/F/H for 3D source files and Unreal pack roots (no file content read, no changes).
$out = "E:\GameDev\Staging\MyProject2_EnvCopy_Claude_20261009\_claude_evidence\inventory"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $out | Out-Null
$ext = @('.fbx', '.glb', '.gltf', '.blend', '.obj', '.usd', '.usda', '.usdc', '.usdz', '.abc', '.dae', '.3ds', '.max', '.ma', '.mb', '.ztl', '.uasset_pack')
$skip = '\\Windows\\|\\Program Files( \(x86\))?\\(?!Epic Games)|\\ProgramData\\Microsoft|\\\$Recycle\.Bin|\\System Volume Information|\\AppData\\Local\\Temp|\\node_modules\\|\\DerivedDataCache\\|\\Intermediate\\|\\\.git\\|\\WinSxS'
$rows = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$rows.Add("path,ext,bytes,mtime_utc")
$uproj = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
foreach ($d in 'C:\', 'E:\', 'F:\', 'H:\') {
  Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -Recurse -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch $skip } | ForEach-Object {
    $e = $_.Extension.ToLower()
    if ($ext -contains $e) { $rows.Add(('"{0}",{1},{2},{3}' -f $_.FullName, $e, $_.Length, $_.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('s'))) }
    elseif ($e -eq '.uproject' -or $e -eq '.uplugin') { $uproj.Add(('"{0}",{1},{2}' -f $_.FullName, $_.Length, $_.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('s'))) }
  }
  "$d done $(Get-Date -Format HH:mm:ss) rows=$($rows.Count)" | Out-File -Append "$out\scan_progress.txt"
}
$rows | Out-File -Encoding utf8 "$out\SCAN_3D_FILES_ALL_DRIVES_20261009.csv"
$uproj | Out-File -Encoding utf8 "$out\SCAN_UPROJECT_UPLUGIN_20261009.csv"
"DONE $(Get-Date -Format s)" | Out-File -Append "$out\scan_progress.txt"

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'E:/GameDev/Tools/TTS_Kokoro/libs')
import numpy as np, zlib, struct
def rd(p):
  b=open(p,'rb').read(); i=8; w=h=0; dat=b''
  while i<len(b):
    n=struct.unpack('>I',b[i:i+4])[0]; t=b[i+4:i+8]; c=b[i+8:i+8+n]; i+=12+n
    if t==b'IHDR': w,h,bd,ct=struct.unpack('>IIBB',c[:10])
    if t==b'IDAT': dat+=c
  raw=zlib.decompress(dat); ch=4 if ct==6 else 3; st=w*ch; out=np.zeros((h,st),np.uint8); prev=np.zeros(st,np.int32)
  for y in range(h):
    f=raw[y*(st+1)]; r=np.frombuffer(raw[y*(st+1)+1:(y+1)*(st+1)],np.uint8).astype(np.int32)
    if f==0: cur=r
    elif f==2: cur=(r+prev)&255
    else:
      cur=np.zeros(st,np.int32)
      for x in range(st):
        a=cur[x-ch] if x>=ch else 0; bb=prev[x]; cc=prev[x-ch] if x>=ch else 0
        if f==1: cur[x]=(r[x]+a)&255
        elif f==3: cur[x]=(r[x]+((a+bb)>>1))&255
        else:
          p=a+bb-cc; pa=abs(p-a); pb=abs(p-bb); pc=abs(p-cc); pr=a if pa<=pb and pa<=pc else (bb if pb<=pc else cc); cur[x]=(r[x]+pr)&255
    out[y]=cur; prev=cur
  return out.reshape(h,w,ch)[:,:,:3]

Fit
Pins: the detector auto-placed 15 on the front, 12 on the profile and 22 on the ¾ view. Wireframe overlays show eye corners, nostrils, mouth corners, chin and nose tip landing on the matching photo features in all three views.
Still unverified or mismatched:
Cheek fullness and jaw width in the front view.
Ear and skull shape, because hair hides them.
Forehead height.
The expression is neutral and generic.
There are no eyeball meshes; the eyes exist only in the texture.
Doubled eye
Cause: a texture projection problem, not geometry. The mesh is one connected piece, with no second eye object. The eye on the right in the front photo (her left eye) showed two pupils at oblique angles. The profile and ¾ photos were projected onto it and blended with the front one.
Test: a front-only bake shows a single pupil.
Fix: the eye regions now use the front photo only, and the pupils render single at oblique angles.
Bald head
Photo-derived: only the face skin comes from the photos.
Reconstructed: the scalp, ears and neck are a neutral skin tone filled in from the face edge. A red/blue mask marks what is photo and what is reconstructed.
Hair: none of it remains.
Renders: I checked front, ¾, both sides and back, with and without texture. I saw no hair, no seam and no black strip under the chin.
Known weaknesses:
The reconstructed skin is slightly darker and flatter than the lit face.
The ears have no photo detail.
The face still carries the photo's lighting and makeup.

Here’s the simple version for the Identity asset Claude already prepared. You do not need to install Headshot 3 for these steps; that is a separate Character Creator tool.

Before starting: save your work in each open app. Don’t force-close anything with unsaved work. We need enough memory and only one person or agent controlling Unreal.

On the left, select Neutral Pose under Poses.
At the bottom, click the existing front-view frame, usually Frame 0. Don’t create another if it’s already there.
At the top, click Track Markers. Wait for the facial lines and dots to appear.
Check that those lines follow the eyelids, lips and nose. Drag misplaced points onto the correct features. Don’t blindly turn off both irises; that depends on the source mesh and tracking result.
Right-click the bottom frame and enable Lock Camera.
Click MetaHuman Identity Solve at the top. Wait for completion. If it fails, copy the exact error rather than clicking it repeatedly.
Compare the fitted result with the original using the A/B views, then save this Identity asset.
That finishes the face-fitting step. Connecting it to the body and building its facial rig are still separate steps.

The most significant part of this recording is Lee repeatedly explaining his learning disability and asking for a verbal explanation—not simply the disagreement about recording the call. Mercy’s representative confirms that his employment has ended but continues directing him to written information rather than explaining the reason aloud. That deserves careful review in the Mercy case, although the recording alone does not establish that the termination was unlawful. Call Recording (2).m4a

The disability-related request is clear
Before the representative announces the termination, Lee says:

“I can’t read too well because I have a learning disability.”

He connects that difficulty to a specific request: continue the conversation rather than rely on documents he cannot readily read. After the termination announcement, he repeats the difficulty and asks:

“Could you please verbally articulate why I am being terminated?”

The representative’s responses include:

“The information I send you will explain it.” Call Recording (2).m4a

That is more specific than merely mentioning a disability. Lee identifies the barrier—difficulty reading—and the assistance he is requesting—an explanation spoken aloud.

EEOC guidance says an accommodation request can be made in ordinary language, orally, without mentioning the ADA or using the words “reasonable accommodation.” It also recognizes qualified readers and accessible workplace communications as possible accommodations.

More directly, the EEOC explains that an employer may need to provide an accommodation so an employee can understand and meaningfully discuss a performance or conduct problem, or participate in an investigation. That makes the repeated requests in this call legally relevant. Whether they establish an actionable failure to accommodate depends on the disability evidence, the nature and timing of the communication, and whether an effective alternative was provided.

An important distinction: requesting help understanding termination information is not the same as requesting that an otherwise lawful termination be canceled.

The recording supports some facts—but does not establish the reason for firing
It directly captures Lee raising the alleged sexual harassment, referring to an earlier meeting and video review, expressing concern about repercussions, and being told his employment has ended. It does not capture Mercy admitting that it fired him for reporting harassment, having a disability, or making the recording. Those explanations are asserted or questioned by Lee and another speaker, not confirmed by the representative. Call Recording (2).m4a

Reporting suspected sexual harassment can be protected even when the underlying allegation is ultimately unproven, provided the applicable reasonable, good-faith standard is met. An employee does not need to arrive with video proof before making a protected complaint.

For retaliation, the important comparison is between the earlier complaint and the actual termination decision: who knew about the complaint, who approved the firing, when they approved it, and whether the documented explanation holds up. Timing, inconsistent explanations, and different treatment of comparable employees can be relevant evidence.

“They decided before the call” would not answer everything
Near the beginning, the representative says she already has written documentation. That suggests advance preparation, but the recording does not establish what those documents said or exactly when termination was approved. Call Recording (2).m4a

A decision made before the call would weaken an argument that something first said during this call caused the firing. But it would not, by itself, resolve whether an earlier harassment complaint influenced that decision.

It also would not erase the recording’s value as evidence of the reading-related requests and the responses to them. The reason for termination and the handling of accessible communication are separate issues to evaluate, even though their legal significance may overlap. An accommodation request does not automatically prevent an employer from carrying out an independently justified termination.

Some legal statements made during the call need qualification
Recording the call: Assuming the relevant recording occurred between participants in Missouri, Missouri law generally permits a participant to record a telephone conversation without the other participant’s consent, subject to the statutory criminal-or-tortious-purpose exception. Another participant’s location could require additional legal analysis. A company policy is not itself a wiretapping statute—but lawful recording does not, by itself, compel someone to continue speaking.

Having an attorney present: There is not a blanket right to bring a private attorney into every private-employer HR meeting. Union representation rights can apply to qualifying investigatory interviews, but those rights are not a general entitlement to outside counsel. A request for disability-related communication assistance is a different issue and should not be confused with a demand for legal representation.

Receiving the reason immediately by phone: Missouri’s service-letter statute creates a written explanation process for qualifying employees and corporations; it does not establish a universal requirement to explain a firing orally during the termination call. It has specific requirements, including a request no later than one year after separation. Here, the stronger question is whether Lee needed an accessible way to receive information Mercy was providing—not whether every employee must receive an immediate spoken explanation.

There are details the other side could use, too
The representative offers to send documents by email or mail. Lee explains that the existing contact information is no longer usable and declines to provide a current mailing address. So this should not be described as Mercy refusing to provide any termination documentation. The narrower, supported concern is its response to his request for information he could understand verbally. Call Recording (2).m4a

Also, the supplied recording contains conversation after Lee says he stopped recording. That needs an accurate explanation of how the file was captured—not speculation. The other side could question those statements, even though that does not automatically establish unlawful recording. Preserve those exchanges rather than removing them. Call Recording (2).m4a

Several voices overlap toward the end. Statements by the person supporting Lee should be identified separately, not attributed to Mercy as admissions.

NYGHTSHADE SECURITY — APPROVED CANON, October 9, 2026
Lee approved the following design. This records requirements, not implemented features. GDD/Player Bible integration remains unconfirmed.

Coverage: functioning cameras cover occupied prison rooms, hallways, cell barracks, rotundas, yard, perimeter, roof approaches and guard towers. Chapel, showers, mausoleum, all tunnels and the warden’s tower are camera-free; nearby cameras must not observe into those spaces. Barracks begin with four cameras intended to cover all three floors, plus outward-facing rotunda cameras; actual sightlines must demonstrate coverage, with unresolved gaps reported.

Hub: the warden’s tower houses video feeds and controls, not cameras. Wraparound desk with monitor panels angled about 45 degrees; every camera has ID, location, live feed, status, selectable enlarged view and map position. Selected feeds receive higher update rates than background thumbnails.

Access: permissions depend on role, assignment, escort, appointment and schedule. Clear restricted-area cues; work permissions expire. Unauthorized entry creates suspicion when witnessed. Playable staff have appropriate role access.

Detection: movement initiates observation, not automatic guilt. Relevant visible actions include fights, weapon attacks, suspected contraband exchange, drug use, unauthorized entry, tattooing and lookout behavior. Normal conversation/recreation generates no misconduct alert. Lighting, distance and occlusion affect confidence; no sight through walls, hidden-inventory inspection or omniscient tracking.

Alerts: record time, camera/location, visible participants, suspected action, confidence and last-seen direction. Observe → investigate → emergency. Multiple observations update one incident, avoiding duplicate alerts or punishment.

Guards: dispatch available reachable patrols through real routes. Routine suspicion sends an investigator; visible violence requests urgent response and backup. Guards investigate what they find and plausible routes after loss of sight, without magical knowledge. Personality affects ambiguous decisions within consistent rules.

Searches: witnessed incidents, authorized investigations or scheduled inspections can trigger searches of actual carried items and specified containers. Track legality, ownership, confiscation and evidence. Empty searches do not fabricate proof. Corrupt guards may accept, refuse or report fictional offers; Manipulation cannot override every guard’s integrity.

Prison states: normal → local investigation → sector restriction → lockdown → recovery. Escalate scope according to severity; announcements explain affected areas. Doors follow intended emergency behavior without permanent softlocks. Forced restrictions preventing exercise exempt inactivity decay.

Discipline: confirmed outcomes use warnings, $5 IN-GAME fines, temporary privilege restrictions and hearings/stronger consequences for serious offenses. Serious offenses need not pass every warning tier. Keep uncertain allegations separate from confirmed violations. Show evidence, reason, duration and expiration. One incident cannot stack accidental fines; serious incidents may affect parole/reputation where supported by canon.

Reliability: show camera outages and maintenance status; unavailable footage does not prove guilt or innocence. Save/load preserves permissions, incidents, fines, restrictions, camera states and prison alert level; restored patrols/investigations do not duplicate sanctions.

Implementation gate: one corridor, one restricted door, two cameras, one monitor and two guards. Test live footage, harmless movement, occlusion, unauthorized-entry investigation, violence/backup, exactly one disciplinary result and restart persistence. Expand only after passing; audit full coverage and every camera-free exception separately.

Read-only scan of C/E/F/H for 3D source files and Unreal pack roots (no file content read, no changes).

$out = "E:\GameDev\Staging\MyProject2_EnvCopy_Claude_20261009_claude_evidence\inventory"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $out | Out-Null
$ext = @('.fbx', '.glb', '.gltf', '.blend', '.obj', '.usd', '.usda', '.usdc', '.usdz', '.abc', '.dae', '.3ds', '.max', '.ma', '.mb', '.ztl', '.uasset_pack')
$skip = '\Windows\|\Program Files( 
x
86
x86)?\(?!Epic Games)|\ProgramData\Microsoft|\$Recycle.Bin|\System Volume Information|\AppData\Local\Temp|\node_modules\|\DerivedDataCache\|\Intermediate\|\.git\|\WinSxS'
$rows = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$rows.Add("path,ext,bytes,mtime_utc")
$uproj = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
foreach ($d in 'C:', 'E:', 'F:', 'H:') {
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -Recurse -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $.FullName -notmatch $skip } | ForEach-Object {
$e = $.Extension.ToLower()
if ($ext -contains $e) { $rows.Add(('"{0}",{1},{2},{3}' -f $.FullName, $e, $.Length, $.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('s'))) }
elseif ($e -eq '.uproject' -or $e -eq '.uplugin') { $uproj.Add(('"{0}",{1},{2}' -f $.FullName, $.Length, $.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('s'))) }
}
"$d done $(Get-Date -Format HH:mm:ss) rows=$($rows.Count)" | Out-File -Append "$out\scan_progress.txt"
}
$rows | Out-File -Encoding utf8 "$out\SCAN_3D_FILES_ALL_DRIVES_20261009.csv"
$uproj | Out-File -Encoding utf8 "$out\SCAN_UPROJECT_UPLUGIN_20261009.csv"
"DONE $(Get-Date -Format s)" | Out-File -Append "$out\scan_progress.txt"

def rd(p):
b=open(p,'rb').read(); i=8; w=h=0; dat=b''
while i<len(b):
n=struct.unpack('>I',b[i:i+4])[0]; t=b[i+4:i+8]; c=b[i+8:i+8+n]; i+=12+n
if t==b'IHDR': w,h,bd,ct=struct.unpack('>IIBB',c[:10])
if t==b'IDAT': dat+=c
raw=zlib.decompress(dat); ch=4 if ct==6 else 3; st=wch; out=np.zeros((h,st),np.uint8); prev=np.zeros(st,np.int32)
for y in range(h):
f=raw[y(st+1)]; r=np.frombuffer(raw[y*(st+1)+1:(y+1)*(st+1)],np.uint8).astype(np.int32)
if f==0: cur=r
elif f==2: cur=(r+prev)&255
else:
cur=np.zeros(st,np.int32)
for x in range(st):

out[y]=cur; prev=cur

$ext = @('.fbx', '.glb', '.gltf', '.blend', '.obj', '.usd', '.usda', '.usdc', '.usdz', '.abc', '.dae', '.3ds', '.max', '.ma', '.mb', '.ztl', '.uasset_pack')
$skip = '\Windows\|\Program Files( 
x
86
x86)?\(?!Epic Games)|\ProgramData\Microsoft|\$Recycle.Bin|\System Volume Information|\AppData\Local\Temp|\node_modules\|\DerivedDataCache\|\Intermediate\|\.git\|\WinSxS'
$rows = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$rows.Add("path,ext,bytes,mtime_utc")
$uproj = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
foreach ($d in 'C:', 'E:', 'F:', 'H:') {
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -Recurse -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $.FullName -notmatch $skip } | ForEach-Object {
$e = $.Extension.ToLower()
if ($ext -contains $e) { $rows.Add(('"{0}",{1},{2},{3}' -f $.FullName, $e, $.Length, $.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('s'))) }
elseif ($e -eq '.uproject' -or $e -eq '.uplugin') { $uproj.Add(('"{0}",{1},{2}' -f $.FullName, $.Length, $.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('s'))) }
}
"$d done $(Get-Date -Format HH:mm:ss) rows=$($rows.Count)" | Out-File -Append "$out\scan_progress.txt"
}
$rows | Out-File -Encoding utf8 "$out\SCAN_3D_FILES_ALL_DRIVES_20261009.csv"
$uproj | Out-File -Encoding utf8 "$out\SCAN_UPROJECT_UPLUGIN_20261009.csv"
"DONE $(Get-Date -Format s)" | Out-File -Append "$out\scan_progress.txt"

import numpy as np, zlib, struct
def rd(p):
b=open(p,'rb').read(); i=8; w=h=0; dat=b''
while i<len(b):
n=struct.unpack('>I',b[i:i+4])[0]; t=b[i+4:i+8]; c=b[i+8:i+8+n]; i+=12+n
if t==b'IHDR': w,h,bd,ct=struct.unpack('>IIBB',c[:10])
if t==b'IDAT': dat+=c
raw=zlib.decompress(dat); ch=4 if ct==6 else 3; st=wch; out=np.zeros((h,st),np.uint8); prev=np.zeros(st,np.int32)
for y in range(h):
f=raw[y(st+1)]; r=np.frombuffer(raw[y*(st+1)+1:(y+1)*(st+1)],np.uint8).astype(np.int32)
if f==0: cur=r
elif f==2: cur=(r+prev)&255
else:
cur=np.zeros(st,np.int32)
for x in range(st):
a=cur[x-ch] if x>=ch else 0; bb=prev[x]; cc=prev[x-ch] if x>=ch else 0
if f==1: cur[x]=(r[x]+a)&255
elif f==3: cur[x]=(r[x]+((a+bb)>>1))&255
else:
p=a+bb-cc; pa=abs(p-a); pb=abs(p-bb); pc=abs(p-cc); pr=a if pa<=pb and pa<=pc else (bb if pb<=pc else cc); cur[x]=(r[x]+pr)&255
out[y]=cur; prev=cur
return out.reshape(h,w,ch)[:,:,:3]
